title: macOS CLOUDFLARED_PATH/local/PATH cloudflared is checked against the .tgz archive digest and copied without extraction
test: tests/packageApp.test.js (23 new tests): 'decideCloudflaredCandidate stages a verified macOS archive only through extraction', '... rejects an explicit and skips an implicit macOS candidate that is not the archive', '... never stages a macOS candidate as-is, whatever the asset', '... keeps the Windows outcomes for bare .exe candidates'; 'stageVerifiedCloudflaredArchive' (snapshot is verified and extracted, nothing extracted or staged on a digest mismatch, the verified bytes are extracted even if the file changes afterwards, a candidate named cloudflared, cleanup on failure); 'on macOS a candidate that is the pinned archive is staged only by extracting it', 'on macOS an explicit candidate that is not the archive is rejected with the reason and never staged', 'on macOS an implicit candidate that is not the archive is skipped with a log line and never staged'; the CLOUDFLARED_PATH / project-root (with and without ALLOW_LOCAL_CLOUDFLARED=1) / PATH lookups on macOS; Windows guards 'on Windows a verified bare .exe candidate is still copied straight to the stage', 'on Windows an unverified candidate keeps the old outcomes...', 'on Windows the lookup still copies a verified project-root .exe directly and skips an unverified PATH one'
proof: The defect: with process.platform faked as darwin, a manifest whose darwin-arm64 digest is the digest of a small fake .tgz, and CLOUDFLARED_PATH set to that .tgz, the unchanged bundleCloudflared() staged a 149-byte file identical to the archive (gzip header 1f8b, no extraction, no chmod) as the `cloudflared` executable; the script is kept as .arbitra/dev-notes/results/TASK-046-repro.js.txt and its output as TASK-046-before.txt. The committed tests call seams that the unchanged code does not have (decideCloudflaredCandidate, stageVerifiedCloudflaredArchive, stageCloudflaredCandidate, stageLocalCloudflared), so all 23 new tests failed there with 'is not a function' and 25 existing ones passed; they cannot show the defect on the unchanged code any other way, because bundleCloudflared reads process.env/process.platform and was not exported, which is why the reproduction harness was used for the defect itself. After the fix all 48 tests in the file pass, and the same harness on the new code stages a 32-byte file (the entry extracted by the real extractCloudflaredFromArchive, using this host's bsdtar in place of /usr/bin/tar) that differs from the archive. The tests pass the platform in and replace the extractor, so they run on any host: with platform darwin a candidate whose bytes match the archive digest is staged only from the extracted entry (the candidate path is never a copy source, the extractor is handed a private copy of the verified bytes, all three staged copies are chmod 0755), a candidate that does not match is never copied or extracted (explicit: error naming the pinned .tgz asset and macOS; project-root/PATH: a 'Skipping ...' log line and the lookup returns false so the verified download runs), project-root files are still ignored without ALLOW_LOCAL_CLOUDFLARED=1; with platform win32 the decision function and the lookup give the old outcomes (verified .exe copied directly, no chmod; unverified explicit throws the old message; unverified implicit skipped).
